description.value: Langley Sportsplex is a major indoor recreation complex housing four ice hockey rinks — described on its own website as the only facility of its kind in Canada — along with a fitness centre, sports equipment retail, health clinics, daycare, and the Offside Cafe. Located roughly 30 minutes from downtown Vancouver, it draws over half a million visitors annually and hosts leagues, tournaments, public skating, training programs, and summer day camps. Touring cyclists in the Fraser Valley would find a sizable hub with on-site food and multiple services, though the facility has no evident cycling focus.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Langley Sportsplex is an active, large-scale indoor ice-sports complex at the OSM address, with a named on-site food outlet (Offside Cafe, referenced in /advertise and /day-camps subpages). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, showers, water refill, or any cyclist-specific amenity appears anywhere in the website text, so all such fields remain null per the evidence-only rule. OSM supplied no phone number; the number 604-882-1611 is sourced from the website only.
concerns: OSM name uses 'SportsPlex' (uppercase P); website consistently renders it 'Sportsplex' (lowercase p).
OSM address omits the suite number; website shows #100 as the unit designation.
OSM record contains no phone number; 604-882-1611 is sourced from the website only and cannot be cross-confirmed against OSM.
Day camps subpage references 2022 dates and pricing, suggesting some website content has not been updated recently.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a large, confirmed-active recreation complex with on-site food, but it is not a cycling-specific attraction and none of the key required cyclist amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are evidenced from the website; the listing's value to touring cyclists is unclear without further on-site verification.
enrichment_extras.notes: Additional on-site tenants named in website: Total Fitness & Wellness, The Hockey Outlet, Complex Hockey Training Facility, Three Peaks Health (kinesiology), Captain Kids Fun Centre, Sportsplex Daycare, and Happy Land Infant Toddler Daycare. General email: info@sportsplexbc.com.
